answer: Agents bond stake and prove Semaphore membership before evaluating a committed epoch polynomial that binds each rate-limit nullifier to a credential. Reusing a nullifier beyond its quota yields two proofs whose differing challenges expose the credential’s secret through Shamir-style interpolation; verifiable evidence then triggers immediate collateral slashing. The ferrous bond, nebula of possible identities, and ivory record of commitments make Sybil creation costly and abuse attributable.
